title: Toys Go to Sleep 🧸 Cozy Tidy-Up Bedtime Story with Luna
intro: Hello, little one. I'm Luna, the sleepy owl. Welcome back to Moonbeam Bedtime.
Tonight, we'll say goodnight to the toys in our playroom.
First, let's take a slow, deep breath together. Breathe in, and breathe out.
Get cozy, snuggle in under your blanket, and listen softly.
Are you ready? Let's begin our story.

lines: Here's a little clue: they're square, colorful, and they stack up tall. Who could it be?
This is Blocks. Can you whisper blocks? Nice and soft.
Blocks stack up, one on top of another.
A wide block at the bottom helps the tower stand up tall.
Can you stack your fists, one on top of the other, slowly?
What do blocks like to do?
Stack up, one on top of another.
Let's say it softly together: Blocks.
One more time, very quietly, like a little whisper: Blocks.
Now the blocks go back in their box, all in a neat little pile.
Here's a little clue: she's soft and floppy, with curly yarn hair. Who could it be?
This is Rag Doll. Can you whisper rag doll? Nice and soft.
A rag doll is made of soft cloth, and she's very cuddly.
Her floppy arms are just right for gentle hugs.
Can you let your arms go soft and floppy, like a rag doll? So relaxed.
What is a rag doll made of?
Let's say it softly together: Rag Doll.
One more time, very quietly, like a little whisper: Rag Doll.
Rag Doll lies down on her little pillow, all floppy and calm.
Goodnight, Rag Doll. Rest your head.
Here's a little clue: it's a wooden horse that rocks back and forth. Who could it be?
This is Rocking Horse. Can you whisper rocking horse? Nice and soft.
A rocking horse sits on two curved rockers.
The curved rockers let it rock gently, back and forth.
Can you rock your body gently, back and forth, back and forth?
How does a rocking horse move?
Back and forth, back and forth, gently.
Let's say it softly together: Rocking Horse.
One more time, very quietly, like a little whisper: Rocking Horse.
Rocking Horse slows down, and down, until it's still and quiet.
Here's a little clue: it has a sail, and it floats on the water. Who could it be?
This is Toy Boat. Can you whisper toy boat? Nice and soft.
Boats float on top of the water.
The sail catches the wind to help the boat move along.
Can you blow a slow, gentle breath, like a breeze for the little sail?
The wind, blowing on its sail.
Let's say it softly together: Toy Boat.
One more time, very quietly, like a little whisper: Toy Boat.
Toy Boat drifts to the edge of the tub, ready to rest.
Here's a little clue: it's a big box where all the toys go at night. Who could it be?
And last, here is: Toy Box.
This is Toy Box. Can you whisper toy box? Nice and soft.
When we put our toys away, they're easy to find tomorrow.
Ball, teddy, blocks, all tucked in, safe and sound.
Can you pretend to put a toy away, gently, in the box?
Where do the toys sleep at night?
In the toy box, all tucked in.
Let's say it softly together: Toy Box.
One more time, very quietly, like a little whisper: Toy Box.
The lid closes softly. The playroom is tidy and quiet.

recap: Let's remember all of our sleepy friends.
Goodnight, Rag Doll. Rest your head.
outro: Goodnight, Blocks, Rag Doll, Rocking Horse, Toy Boat, and Toy Box. Now close your eyes, and dream sweet, gentle dreams.
Goodnight, little one. Luna loves you. Sleep tight.
